decisions.reason: As the flagship platform at the core of the firm's strategic direction, D anchors the established geospatial business, so it meets aspirations and there is no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search toward dropping it.

Mobile field data capture is close to the core offer and had a page of its own in both observed years, and the firm's slack from its broad portfolio lets it carry the product even though later evidence is missing.
The search extension was still being developed in 2019 (version 1.6.0) and complements the platform ecosystem, so it seems to meet aspirations, unlike the smaller plugins that were already pruned.
